Ignore all reference text, labels, dots, outlines, 3D facets and shading. NO stroke around any boundary. Character proportions and original hat/beard shapes must be preserved. Body includes hat/head/torso/apron only. Short cream sleeve stubs end at shoulders, NO skin arms, NO hands, NO legs, NO boots, NO shadow, no ground, no markers, no text. Apron ends in flat shallow hem. Front-facing straight symmetric south view; only his front visible. True transparent background.
Output square 1024x1024, to be mechanically downsampled to 512. Virtual 512 coordinates: entire body silhouette x=142..370, hat top y=80, hat brim y=136..158, shoulders approximately (190,224),(322,224), apron hem y=352. Everything below y=352 fully empty. Body height 272 virtual pixels; eventual ground y=444 with legs/boots not drawn. Sleeve stubs broad enough to join 18px virtual arms. Body shoulders end around y=250. Keep front view hat level and silhouette compact. Reference image is design reference only. Render ONE body sprite, nothing else.
